16:
At the Safari Zone, you play the
Safari Game, where you get {STRVAR_1 51, 1, 0} Safari Balls to catch homies.When you run outta Safari Balls,
the game over.When you see a homie, you can
throw Bait or Mud.Throw Bait, and homies usually stay
but get harder to catch.Throw Mud, and they easier
to catch, but they might dip.Have fun at the Safari Zone!
17: Have fun at the Safari Zone!
18: Warden Baoba got somethin' important\nto tell you!
19: This the Area Customizer.\nWhat you wanna know about? {YESNO 0}
20: The Safari Zone got six Areas.\rPlains Area...\nPeak Area...\fand so on.\rThe Area Customizer let you\nswitch up the combo of Areas.\rWhat else you wanna know? {YESNO 0}
21:
Check the machine, and you'll see
the Area Customizer screen.The bottom window show the current
Safari Zone setup.Pick an Area with the A Button to
swap it with another one.What else you wanna know? {YESNO 0}
22: When you pick an Area, then pick\nSwap, you'll see 12 new Areas.\rHighlight one and\npress the A Button.\rWhat else you wanna know? {YESNO 0}
23: When you pick an Area, then pick\nOrder, the Area type stay the same,\fbut you can move where it's at.\rWhat else you wanna know? {YESNO 0}
24: Different Areas got different homies\nlivin' in 'em, so when you switch\fAreas, you see different homies.\rDefinitely try different Areas!\nWhat else you wanna know? {YESNO 0}
